status: G3 rest: processed, compressed and reviewed; in the game at the Follow and Overview cameras of Chapters V and VI (desktop build, High)
use: A section of the camp wall: drawn along the mudbrick-walled camps' wall cells, instanced, in place of the code-built parapet.

generator.prompt: A straight section of the mudbrick enclosure wall of a Roman fort on the desert frontier, about five metres long, two and a half metres high and one metre thick: sun-dried mud bricks laid in courses on a footing of rough fieldstones, coated in cracked mud plaster that has fallen away in patches to show the brickwork, a rounded parapet with small stepped crenellations along one face. Pale sandy brown and ochre. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side.
